rows.summary: BLS International Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018 that we are enclosing herewith a Confirmation certificate dated April 03, 2026 for the fourth quarter and year ended March 31, 2026, as received from Registrar and Transfer Agent (RTA) of the Company i.e. Beetal Financial & Computer Services (P) Limited pursuant to Regulation 74(5) of Securities Exchange Board of India (Depositoriesand Participants) Regulation, 2018, as amended, from time to time.
